content: Over ten epochs, the model parameterization which performs the best uses GloVe vectors trained on a corpus consisting of all listing descriptions and ensembling to make its class prediction. As a result, our findings are well in-line with those presented by Radford et. al who underscore the importance of training word embeddings on a data-specific corpus for best results on generative tasks [9].
